# Phoenix Global

> Phoenix Global Corporation sources and exports textiles, fashion goods, accessories, paper and recycled products, electronics and commodities (sugar, coffee) from India, China and Latin America to North America, Europe, Africa and the Middle East. It also helps Indian D2C brands with OEM/ODM matching and white-label sourcing.

## Pages
- Sourcing, Products, Global Reach, D2C and brand consulting (India), Partner, Contact, Insights, Compliance
